scope: Sixteen fixed runs on four known self-authored repository feature tasks; not SWE-bench issue scores, held-out evidence, native-default performance or statistical parity.

aggregate.projection_note: Preserves metrics, distinctions and evidence bindings; omits model answers, source/summary quotations and repeated review prose. Raw aggregate and originals remain private and unchanged.

ratio_scope: All-outcome cost or summed saved time divided by qualified successes; null when none. Agent and run elapsed fields exclude grading/analysis and are not end-to-end cohort wall time. Decimal strings preserve aggregate precision.

accounting.basis: Frozen configured prices applied to saved usage; fully settled internal accounting, not an independently verified provider invoice.

configuration.pi_tool_deadlines: Native/model-supplied; no matched per-tool timeout claim.
configuration.pi_context: Native SDK context management, no virtual-window override; external body/call/time/output limits still apply. Lean-looking compaction fields in the common mode object do not configure native Pi compaction.
configuration.isolation: Lean nested bubblewrap; Pi native tools in ordinary outer Docker. Isolated Docker image/container layers on RAM storage, audit copies on durable disk.
configuration.effort_correction: Frozen off-to-low shorthand was not established. Exact pinned SDK synthetic construction produced adaptive thinking, top-level output_config.effort=low and final system-message output_config.effort=high. Actual historical request settings were not retained; no effective-effort matching or historical-byte identity claim.

criteria.task_artifact: Frozen feature checker and required original tests, plus independent exact-patch review against full task including tests/docs. Automated checker success alone is not qualification.
criteria.normal_finish: Normal completed terminal state; failure/interruption/admission limits remain explicit.
criteria.continuation: Restart mode requires at least2accepted summaries, useful later request across recorded process restart, exact history/context/frame/accounting reconstruction.
criteria.independent_summary_fidelity: Apply copied frozen qualitative rubric with model reviewer identity; no unsupported causal claims.
criteria.denominator: All16fixed slots; remaining unstarted/interrupted slots explicitly retained, no replacements or hidden retries.

qualification.interpretation: Task artifact, normal finish, settled execution/accounting, applicable session/continuation checks and independent exact-patch review. This is not a score for all instruction adherence or perfect summaries. Reviews are trusted independent Codex model judgments, not proof or asserted human review.
qualification.correction_scope: Three separately reviewed exact-prefix reconstructions add omitted checkpoint turn metadata. Original results, failed audits, checker verdicts, patches and manual judgments remain unchanged; no new model execution or criterion relaxation.

memory_scope.scope: Whole candidate container during agent invocation, including page cache; not process RSS or exact instantaneous peak.
memory_scope.diagnostic_scope: memory.events normally includes descendants unless memory_localevents is enabled. Counters identify neither OOM victim nor cause of exit137; unavailable diagnostics stay unknown.

interventions.scope: Operator and reviewer declarations, not an independent proof that all external intervention was impossible. Planned automatic restarts are separate.
interventions.journal_scope: Exact additional administrative record kinds in twelve Lean journals; Pi has no corresponding Lean-journal observation. Initial session turn is not an additional user_turn record.

summary_fidelity_scope: All38 accepted summaries reviewed against frozen requirements, actual source ranges and next complete contexts. Findings are qualitative; no validated fidelity percentage or failure-caused-by-compaction inference. Zero native Pi summaries means unexercised, not a fidelity pass.
